title: Organic initiate never clears a stale first-touch cookie left by an abandoned OAuth attempt, so the next callback can consume it
evidence:
case first_touch_cookie.from_initiate_query(wisp.get_query(req)) {
        [] -> response
        pairs ->
          response
          |> wisp.set_cookie(
            req,
            cookie_names.first_touch(),
            first_touch_cookie.cookie_value(pairs),
            wisp.Signed,
            first_touch_cookie.max_age,
          )
      }
detail: Module docstring promises the cookie is 'cleared on every terminal OAuth response' so stale attribution can't leak into a later attempt, but an abandoned flow (tab closed at accounts.google.com) produces no terminal response, and the `[] -> response` branch leaves the old cookie in place. A same-browser organic signup inside the 300s window then inherits the abandoned attempt's UTM params as $set_once first-touch.
recommended_fix: On the `[] -> response` branch, also `|> first_touch_cookie.clear_cookie(req)` — an organic initiate should never leave a prior flow's cookie readable by the next callback.

title: find_set_cookie now exists in five test files; no shared helper exists, but per-file duplication is the established convention
detail: Answer to the lens question: two private copies pre-date this diff (cookie_attributes_test, csrf_cookie_test), so the three new copies match existing convention rather than violating it; the integration copy even comments 'mirrors cookie_attributes_test.find_set_cookie'. Not a defect, but the count is now five.
recommended_fix: Leave as-is per convention; if a sixth copy appears, extract one shared helper into server/test/helpers and migrate the five call sites.

title: first_touch_cookie.max_age (300) is a disconnected mirror of auth_handler.pkce_max_age (300)
detail: The docstring documents 'same max-age as the PKCE verifier' as the invariant, but the two constants live in separate modules with no shared source. A future security-driven shortening of pkce_max_age would silently leave the attribution cookie outliving the PKCE window.
recommended_fix: Export pkce_max_age from auth_handler (or move both to a shared auth constants module) and reference it from first_touch_cookie.
